items.title: David N. Baker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he had a big hit with My Fair Lady with Mia Farrow’s husband.

ctx.x: Freddie Hubbard. I can remember the day we learned Donna Lee. We spent until we got that baby where we could play it at some ridiculous tempo. Then we decided we weren’t going to let them know that we had practiced it. So I dropped Freddie several blocks from the thing, and I went on there, so we got there at different times. Then at the end of the session, Freddie said, “Do you know Donna Lee?” There were a couple of other horns on there. I said, “Donna Lee? I don’t know. Let’s just play through it quietly.” We…
